question: What consequence follows from abstaining from food during the day?
premises: Non-eating by day is specified as the means
Death related to age is named as the outcome
The verse states this as a future result
inference: By abstaining from food during the day, one will go to death from age
uncertainties: The intended sense may be overcoming or reaching the limit of age-related death; the syntax is compressed
plain_english: By not eating during the day, one will go to death from age.
